However, the dark grey piece is sitting at position $(0,0,1)$ (front-middle-top), and we established that the dark grey piece likely extends to $(0,1,1)$ (front-middle-back). If the white piece occupied $(0,0,0)$, the dark grey piece would have a "floating" block unless it also goes to the back, creating a gap in the center column.
    *   Option B (Straight 2x2 L-shape) is a "flat" L-shape. If the white piece is Option B, it fits snugly into the "hole" formed by the other two pieces. It occupies the front-right column (2 cubes) and the front-middle-bottom cube (which is a hole, as seen in the top face), and the center-back-bottom cube.
